text:
Scheme: PM-KISAN Official Guidelines (ID: CEN-AGR-001) | Level: Central | State: None | Category: agriculture | Section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM-KISAN | Page: 1

OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM-KISAN
Ministry / Department: Agriculture & Farmers Welfare | Level: Central
Target State: None
1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE & SCOPE
Income support to landholding farmer families
Category: agriculture. Subcategory: General.
Launch Year: 2019. Current Operational Status: year_round.
2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA & CONDITIONS
The following deterministic conditions must be satisfied for beneficiary selection:
 - Is a farmer (Field: occupation, Op: eq, Value: farmer)
 - Owns cultivable land (Field: owns_land, Op: eq, Value: True)
 - No family member paid income tax in last assessment year (Field: is_income_tax_payer, Op: eq, Value: False)
3. FINANCIAL BENEFIT & ENTITLEMENTS
Benefit Type: grant
Maximum Benefit Amount: Rs 6,000 (yearly (3 instalments))
Repayment Obligation: Non-refundable financial grant / subsidy
Official Guidelines | | CEN-AGR-001

document_title: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) Official Guidelines
section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM FASAL BIMA YOJANA (PMFBY)
text:
Scheme: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) Official Guidelines (ID: CEN-AGR-002) | Level: Central | State: None | Category: agriculture | Section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM FASAL BIMA YOJANA (PMFBY) | Page: 1

OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM FASAL BIMA YOJANA (PMFBY)
Ministry / Department: Agriculture & Farmers Welfare | Level: Central
Target State: None
1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE & SCOPE
Subsidised crop insurance against yield loss from weather, pests and disease. Enrolment cut-off dates are
notified by each state per season (Rabi usually Oct-Nov).
Category: agriculture. Subcategory: General.
Launch Year: 2016. Current Operational Status: seasonal.
2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA & CONDITIONS
The following deterministic conditions must be satisfied for beneficiary selection:
 - Farmer (owner, tenant or sharecropper with valid papers) (Field: occupation, Op: eq, Value: farmer)
 - Grows a notified crop in a notified area (Field: grows_notified_crop, Op: eq, Value: True)
3. FINANCIAL BENEFIT & ENTITLEMENTS
Benefit Type: insurance
Maximum Benefit Amount: Rs 0 (per season; farmer pays 2% (kharif food/oilseed), 1.5% (rabi food/oilseed), up
to 5% (commercial/horticulture) of sum insured)
Repayment Obligation: Non-refundable financial grant / subsidy
Official Guidelines | | CEN-AGR-002

document_title: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana Official Guidelines
section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM KISAN MAANDHAN YOJANA
text:
Scheme: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana Official Guidelines (ID: CEN-AGR-003) | Level: Central | State: None | Category: agriculture | Section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM KISAN MAANDHAN YOJANA | Page: 1

OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM KISAN MAANDHAN YOJANA
Ministry / Department: Agriculture & Farmers Welfare | Level: Central
Target State: None
1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE & SCOPE
Voluntary contributory pension: farmer pays Rs 55-200/month by entry age, Centre matches; Rs 3,000/month
pension from age 60, 50% family pension to spouse. Managed by LIC.
Category: agriculture. Subcategory: General.
Launch Year: 2019. Current Operational Status: year_round.
2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA & CONDITIONS
The following deterministic conditions must be satisfied for beneficiary selection:
 - Small/marginal farmer (Field: occupation, Op: eq, Value: farmer)
 - Entry age 18-40 (Field: age, Op: between, Value: [18, 40])
 - Cultivable land up to 2 hectares in land records (Field: landholding_hectares, Op: lte, Value: 2)
 - Not an income-tax payer / not in other exclusions (Field: is_income_tax_payer, Op: eq, Value: False)
3. FINANCIAL BENEFIT & ENTITLEMENTS
Benefit Type: pension
Maximum Benefit Amount: Rs 36,000 (yearly (Rs 3,000/month after 60))
Repayment Obligation: Non-refundable financial grant / subsidy
Official Guidelines | | CEN-AGR-003

document_title: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) Official Guidelines
section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM MATRU VANDANA YOJANA (PMMVY)
text:
Scheme: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) Official Guidelines (ID: CEN-WCW-001) | Level: Central | State: None | Category: women_child | Section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM MATRU VANDANA YOJANA (PMMVY) | Page: 1

OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM MATRU VANDANA YOJANA (PMMVY)
Ministry / Department: Women & Child Development (Mission Shakti) | Level: Central
Target State: None
1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE & SCOPE
Conditional cash transfer for pregnant and lactating women under Mission Shakti (PMMVY 2.0, from 1 April
2022). Registration during pregnancy needed; instalments depend on ANC check-up and child's immunisation.
Category: women_child. Subcategory: General.
Launch Year: 2017. Current Operational Status: year_round.
2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA & CONDITIONS
The following deterministic conditions must be satisfied for beneficiary selection:
 - Woman (Field: gender, Op: eq, Value: female)
 - Pregnant/lactating (first living child) (Field: is_pregnant_or_lactating, Op: eq, Value: True)
3. FINANCIAL BENEFIT & ENTITLEMENTS
Benefit Type: grant
Maximum Benefit Amount: Rs 6,000 (Rs 5,000 for first living child (2 instalments: 3,000 + 2,000); Rs 6,000 for a
second child if a girl (one instalment))
Repayment Obligation: Non-refundable financial grant / subsidy
Official Guidelines | | CEN-WCW-001

document_title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana Official Guidelines
section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: SUKANYA SAMRIDDHI YOJANA
text:
Scheme: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana Official Guidelines (ID: CEN-WCW-002) | Level: Central | State: None | Category: women_child | Section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: SUKANYA SAMRIDDHI YOJANA | Page: 1

OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: SUKANYA SAMRIDDHI YOJANA
Ministry / Department: Finance (National Savings Institute / India Post) | Level: Central
Target State: None
1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE & SCOPE
Government small-savings account for a girl child below 10, opened by a parent/guardian. Deposits qualify for
tax deduction; interest and maturity are tax-free. One account per girl.
Category: women_child. Subcategory: General.
Launch Year: 2015. Current Operational Status: year_round.
2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA & CONDITIONS
The following deterministic conditions must be satisfied for beneficiary selection:
 - Girl child (Field: child_gender, Op: eq, Value: female)
 - Girl is below 10 years on account-opening date (Field: child_age, Op: lte, Value: 9)
3. FINANCIAL BENEFIT & ENTITLEMENTS
Benefit Type: savings
Maximum Benefit Amount: Rs 150,000 (savings: Rs 250-1.5 lakh deposit/yr for 15 yrs, matures at 21 yrs; interest
8.2% p.a. (Oct-Dec 2026), reviewed quarterly)
Repayment Obligation: Non-refundable financial grant / subsidy
Official Guidelines | | CEN-WCW-002

section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM MUDRA YOJANA
text:
Scheme: PM Mudra Yojana Official Guidelines (ID: CEN-BUS-001) | Level: Central | State: None | Category: business | Section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM MUDRA YOJANA | Page: 1

OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM MUDRA YOJANA
Ministry / Department: Finance | Level: Central
Target State: None
1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE & SCOPE
Collateral-free loans for non-farm micro/small businesses. Tarun Plus (Rs 10-20 lakh, from 24 Oct 2024) is only
for borrowers who repaid an earlier Tarun loan.
Category: business. Subcategory: General.
Launch Year: 2015. Current Operational Status: year_round.
2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA & CONDITIONS
The following deterministic conditions must be satisfied for beneficiary selection:
 - Age 18 or above (Field: age, Op: gte, Value: 18)
 - Has a non-farm business plan (Field: has_business_plan, Op: eq, Value: True)
3. FINANCIAL BENEFIT & ENTITLEMENTS
Benefit Type: loan
Maximum Benefit Amount: Rs 2,000,000 (one-time loan: Shishu up to 50k, Kishore up to 5 lakh, Tarun up to 10
lakh, Tarun Plus up to 20 lakh)
Repayment Obligation: Repayment required with applicable terms
Official Guidelines | | CEN-BUS-001

text:
Scheme: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) Official Guidelines (ID: CEN-HOU-001) | Level: Central | State: None | Category: housing | Section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM AWAS YOJANA - GRAMIN (PMAY-G) | Page: 1

OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: PM AWAS YOJANA - GRAMIN (PMAY-G)
Ministry / Department: Rural Development | Level: Central
Target State: None
1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE & SCOPE
Unit assistance for a pucca house (min 25 sq m) for rural households with no house or a kutcha house; extended
to March 2029 for 2 crore more houses. Rs 12,000 extra for a toilet via convergence.
Category: housing. Subcategory: General.
Launch Year: 2016. Current Operational Status: year_round.
2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA & CONDITIONS
The following deterministic conditions must be satisfied for beneficiary selection:
 - Rural household (Field: residence, Op: eq, Value: rural)
 - No pucca house (houseless or kutcha house up to 2 rooms) (Field: has_pucca_house, Op: eq, Value: False)
 - Name in verified Awaas+/SECC beneficiary list (Gram Sabha verified) (Field: awaas_plus_listed, Op: eq,
Value: True)
 - Household income up to Rs 15,000/month (relaxed in 2024) (Field: monthly_household_income, Op: lte,
Value: 15000)
3. FINANCIAL BENEFIT & ENTITLEMENTS
Benefit Type: subsidy
Maximum Benefit Amount: Rs 130,000 (one-time, paid in instalments (Rs 1.20 lakh plains / Rs 1.30 lakh NE and
hill states))
Repayment Obligation: Non-refundable financial grant / subsidy
Official Guidelines | | CEN-HOU-001

Benefit Type: pension

usually add a top-up)
Repayment Obligation: Non-refundable financial grant / subsidy

Target State: None

Financial assistance to early-stage startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, and
market entry

The following deterministic conditions must be satisfied for beneficiary selection:

True)
 - Has business idea to develop a product or service with market fit (Field: has_innovative_idea, Op: eq, Value:
True)
 - Has not received more than Rs 10 lakh of monetary support from central/state govt (Field:
prior_funding_received, Op: lte, Value: 1000000)
3. FINANCIAL BENEFIT & ENTITLEMENTS
Benefit Type: grant
Maximum Benefit Amount: Rs 5,000,000 (milestone-based grant / convertible debenture)
Repayment Obligation: Non-refundable financial grant / subsidy

OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: HARYANA BHAVANTAR BHARPAYEE YOJA
Ministry / Department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Haryana | Level: State
Target State: Haryana

Risk mitigation and price deficit compensation to horticulture and millet/bajra farmers when market prices drop
below protected floor prices
Category: agriculture. Subcategory: General.
Launch Year: 2018. Current Operational Status: seasonal.

 - Farmer cultivating crops in Haryana (Field: state, Op: eq, Value: Haryana)

Benefit Type: grant
Maximum Benefit Amount: Rs 45,000 (seasonal deficit payment per quintal)
Repayment Obligation: Non-refundable financial grant / subsidy
Official Guidelines | | HR-AGR-001

section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: SANJAY GANDHI NIRADHAR ANUDAN YOJ
text:
Scheme: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana Official Guidelines (ID: MH-EMP-001) | Level: State | State: Maharashtra | Category: employment_pension | Section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: SANJAY GANDHI NIRADHAR ANUDAN YOJ | Page: 1

OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: SANJAY GANDHI NIRADHAR ANUDAN YOJ
Ministry / Department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department Maharashtra | Level: State
Target State: Maharashtra
1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE & SCOPE
Monthly financial pension to destitute persons, blind, disabled, orphans, destitute women and persons suffering
from major illness
Category: employment_pension. Subcategory: General.
Launch Year: 1980. Current Operational Status: year_round.
2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA & CONDITIONS
The following deterministic conditions must be satisfied for beneficiary selection:
 - Resident of Maharashtra for minimum 15 years (Field: state, Op: eq, Value: Maharashtra)
 - Family annual income not exceeding Rs 50,000 (or Rs 21,000 for single person) (Field: annual_income, Op:
lte, Value: 50000)
 - Condition (Field: None, Op: None, Value: None)
3. FINANCIAL BENEFIT & ENTITLEMENTS
Benefit Type: pension
Maximum Benefit Amount: Rs 18,000 (monthly (Rs 1,500/month))
Repayment Obligation: Non-refundable financial grant / subsidy
Official Guidelines | | MH-EMP-001

OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: BAL SANGOPAN YOJANA (FOSTER CARE 
Ministry / Department: Women and Child Development Department Maharashtra | Level: State
Target State: Maharashtra

Monthly financial aid to foster parents and single mothers caring for orphaned, abandoned, or destitute children

Maximum Benefit Amount: Rs 30,000 (monthly (Rs 2,500/month))

section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: RAMAI AWAS GHARKUL YOJANA
text:
Scheme: Ramai Awas Gharkul Yojana Official Guidelines (ID: MH-HOU-001) | Level: State | State: Maharashtra | Category: housing | Section: OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: RAMAI AWAS GHARKUL YOJANA | Page: 1

OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: RAMAI AWAS GHARKUL YOJANA
Ministry / Department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department Maharashtra | Level: State
Target State: Maharashtra
1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE & SCOPE
Financial assistance for construction of pucca houses for Scheduled Caste and Neo-Buddhist homeless families
in rural and urban areas
Category: housing. Subcategory: General.
Launch Year: 2011. Current Operational Status: year_round.
2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA & CONDITIONS
The following deterministic conditions must be satisfied for beneficiary selection:
 - Resident of Maharashtra for 15+ years (Field: state, Op: eq, Value: Maharashtra)
 - Belongs to Scheduled Caste or Neo-Buddhist community (Field: social_category, Op: in, Value: ['SC',
'Neo-Buddhist'])
 - Does not own a pucca house in the state (Field: has_pucca_house, Op: eq, Value: False)
 - Family income not exceeding Rs 1 lakh (rural) / Rs 1.5 lakh (urban) (Field: annual_income, Op: lte, Value:
100000)
3. FINANCIAL BENEFIT & ENTITLEMENTS
Benefit Type: grant
Maximum Benefit Amount: Rs 250,000 (staged construction grant)
Repayment Obligation: Non-refundable financial grant / subsidy
Official Guidelines | | MH-HOU-001

Ministry / Department: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare West Bengal | Level: State
Target State: West Bengal
1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE & SCOPE
Basic monthly income support to female heads of household aged 25-60 years to empower women economically
Category: women_child. Subcategory: General.

OFFICIAL OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES: RUPASHREE PRAKALPA
Ministry / Department: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare West Bengal | Level: State
Target State: West Bengal
1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE & SCOPE
One-time financial grant of Rs 25,000 to economically stressed families at the time of their adult daughter's first
marriage
Category: women_child. Subcategory: General.
Launch Year: 2018. Current Operational Status: year_round.
2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA & CONDITIONS
The following deterministic conditions must be satisfied for beneficiary selection:
 - Resident of West Bengal for at least 5 years (Field: state, Op: eq, Value: West Bengal)
 - Bride age is 18 years or above; groom 21 or above (Field: child_age, Op: gte, Value: 18)
 - Family annual income not exceeding Rs 1.50 lakh (Field: annual_income, Op: lte, Value: 150000)
 - Proposed marriage is the applicant's first marriage (Field: is_first_marriage, Op: eq, Value: True)
3. FINANCIAL BENEFIT & ENTITLEMENTS
Benefit Type: grant
Maximum Benefit Amount: Rs 25,000 (one-time grant before marriage)
Repayment Obligation: Non-refundable financial grant / subsidy
Official Guidelines | | WB-WCW-003
